newsitem.title: USA: Central Garden & Pet sells note placement.
newsitem.headline: Central Garden & Pet sells note placement.

text.p: Central Garden & Pet Co has sold in a private placement $100 million aggregate principal amount of 6.0-percent convertible subordinated notes due 2003, a company statement said.
The statement said the notes are not callable for three years and will be convertible into Central Garden Common Stock at an initial conversion price of $28.00 per share.
The company will use the net proceeds of the offering to repay short- and long-term debt and finance possible acquisitions, among other things, it said.
Central Garden & Pet Co is a national distributor of lawn, garden and pet supply products.
